description: Fork of exp567 (E=96, full LUT arch + per-layer residual_lut + untied Linear(D, V), 1.4768). ADD parallel UNTIED Linear(E=96, V) head from final E-stream with its own LayerNorm(E). logits = Linear_D(ln_d(x_resid)) + Linear_E(ln_e(x_lut)). Tests whether SEPARATE-WEIGHTS dual-head stacks better than the tied dot dual-head in exp582/583 (which capped at +0.04 vs exp567). Hypothesis: tied-dot E-head is constrained to predict in tok_emb_E directions that overlap with what Linear_D learns; an UNTIED Linear_E can learn orthogonal prediction directions. Predicted +3.15M params -> ~106M total. Predicted +100 Mbits head bandwidth (E=96 * V=32768 * 32) -> ~575 Mbits total (trunk unchanged at 72). If exp584 beats exp567's 1.4768, the dual UNTIED head stacks where dual TIED head didn't. Refs: exp567 1.4768 (parent), exp583 1.5200 (E=192 + per-layer resid + dual TIED head — failed to stack), exp582 ~1.53 (1 final resid + dual TIED — failed), exp328 tied vanilla 1.3882, exp476 untied vanilla 1.4143.
